summary.text: You can find your property's Annual Value by checking your tax bill, using the IRAS e-Valuation List, or logging in online.

steps.name: Check tax bill
steps.text: Check your property tax bill to see the Annual Value.

steps.name: Log in online
steps.text: Log in to myTax.iras.gov.sg to check your property details.

steps.name: Use e-Valuation List
steps.text: Find out about the AV of your residence from IRAS e-Valuation List at a nominal fee.
